description: The proofs of website/data/status.json and of the features of website/product.json: for each item label (feature title), files that must be in the tree and commands (sh -c from the repository root, sh, grep, sed, awk, find and jq only) that must exit 0 and print expect; and the counts the site states, each with the command that computes it. Checked by tools/docs-check.d/40-status-claims.sh in task check and in the docs build.

The domain model.command: awk '/^  spec:$/{f=1;next} /^  [a-z-]+:$/{f=0} f&&/^      - ess specify validate --path ess --strict-requires$/{ok=1} END{exit !ok}' Taskfile.yml
awk '/^  check:$/{f=1;next} /^  [a-z-]+:$/{f=0} f&&/^      - task: spec$/{ok=1} END{exit !ok}' Taskfile.yml

Layer rule.command: awk '/^  layers:$/{f=1;next} /^  [a-z-]+:$/{f=0} f&&/^      - tools\/check-layers\.sh$/{ok=1} END{exit !ok}' Taskfile.yml
awk '/^  check:$/{f=1;next} /^  [a-z-]+:$/{f=0} f&&/^      - task: layers$/{ok=1} END{exit !ok}' Taskfile.yml

cloudspec-sim explore.command: grep -cF -- '- cargo install --git https://github.com/beyond10x/cloudspec --rev {{.CLOUDSPEC_REV}} cloudspec-sim --locked --root target/cloudspec-sim' Taskfile.yml

task check.command: awk '/^  check:$/{f=1;next} /^  [a-z-]+:$/{f=0} f&&/^      - task: /{t[$3]=1} END{exit !(t["spec"]&&t["layers"]&&t["stamped-time"]&&t["ci-paths"]&&t["docs-check"]&&t["test"])}' Taskfile.yml

cloudspec-sim.command: grep -cF -- '- cargo install --git https://github.com/beyond10x/cloudspec --rev {{.CLOUDSPEC_REV}} cloudspec-sim --locked --root target/cloudspec-sim' Taskfile.yml

layers.command: awk '/^  - [0-9]+-[a-z-]+\/[a-z-]+\.yaml$/{sub(/^  - /, ""); sub(/-.*/, ""); s[$0] = 1} END{for (k in s) n++; print n+0}' ess/ess-inputs.yaml
